editorial.blurb: Raizes is a dimly lit Mexican cocktail bar where skillfully made margaritas and creative tacos make for a lively neighborhood escape.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit up Taco Tuesday when tacos are just $4 each, or catch Happy Hour for $8 house margaritas—great value on both drinks and food.

topDishes.note: standout with tons of meat and pineapple chunks
delicious and worth ordering—try the jalapeno or classic
